description: Base transaction lookup by hash: sender, recipient, ETH value, block, success or failure, gas used and log count, with the receipt folded in, live from Base mainnet. Use it to confirm a payment or transfer landed on-chain. Input: hash (the 0x transaction hash). For the raw receipt use chain.rpc. $0.05 per call. Returns: from, to, value_eth, block_number, status, gas_used, log_count.

language.description: Optional BCP-47 language tag (en, ja, ko, pt-BR): the human-readable strings of the result (notes, details, reasons) are translated into this language; data, codes, numbers and URLs are untouched. Default: as produced.

name: hubvibe_chain_transaction
title: Base transaction lookup
